preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n for ui, vi, xi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid nodes within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= 10**9 + 6 for ui, vi, xi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: The clamminess of each thread is between 1 and 10^9 + 6.

preconditions.expression: all(ci in {0, 1} for ui, vi, xi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each thread color is either 0 (red) or 1 (black).

postconditions.description: The output is the product of clamminesses of all valid paths modulo 10^9 + 7.
